model: Xinghuo Fully Automatic Sewing Control System Gen-II HMI
manufacturer: Shenzhen Xing Huo CNC Technology Co., Ltd. (星火数控科技有限公司)
controllerType: Universal CNC template sewing controller (XH Gen-II)
type: Third-party automatic template sewing controller used in CNC sewing machines with XY servo axes
source: 全自动缝纫控制系统操作说明书2.0-英文.pdf (148 pages)
note: This is NOT a Jack-branded product. It is a Xinghuo (Xing Huo / 星火) universal controller used in template/auto sewing machines, potentially including some Jack automatic models. Power: 220V AC, 1-2KW. Display: 7-inch LCD touch screen. Parameter files use .xhp extension. Machine parameters require service personnel.

troubleshooting.cause: Thread break detection triggered; can be false-positive in first few stitches
troubleshooting.solution: Adjust Thread Breaking Detection → 'Ignore the number of stitches when sewing' (default 3) to increase ignored start stitches. Check 'Automatic break detection' is Yes. Verify thread sensor is connected.

troubleshooting.issue: Machine not starting / requires high input IO
troubleshooting.cause: Work enable input IO setting (Delay Setting) is non-zero, requiring a specific input signal to be high before work can start
troubleshooting.solution: Set 'Work enable input IO' to 0 to disable this requirement, or ensure the corresponding input IO is at high level.

troubleshooting.cause: Statistic Setting: bobbin line count reached total length
troubleshooting.solution: Replace bobbin. Set 'Stop working when run out of bobbin line' to No to disable this stop, or increase bobbin total length setting.

troubleshooting.issue: Speed is lower than set value
troubleshooting.cause: Speed Ratio settings reducing actual spindle speed
troubleshooting.solution: Check Speed Ratio parameters. High/Mid-high/Mid-low/Low speed ratios (default 100%/90%/70%/60%) multiply the set speed. Verify 'Spdrate' in Axis Run Parameter is ALL or appropriate percentage.

troubleshooting.issue: Pattern alignment is wrong / stitches offset from template
troubleshooting.cause: Origin not set correctly or No datum X/Y offset set incorrectly
troubleshooting.solution: Run XY origin detection from main interface. In benchmark-free mode, verify No datum X/Y offset values in Platen Size Setting.

troubleshooting.issue: Frame slams down or has incorrect pressing timing
troubleshooting.cause: Platen delay settings or presser foot delay settings need adjustment
troubleshooting.solution: Adjust Delay Setting → 'Presser foot delays pressing down' and 'Presser foot delays uplifting'. Also check Auto Process → 'No. of stitches to lower for Start and End presser foot'.

troubleshooting.issue: XY axis runs too fast or too slow during air travel
troubleshooting.cause: Speed Parameter → frame moving speed set incorrectly
troubleshooting.solution: Adjust 'The speed of frame moving (mm/min)' in Speed Parameter (default 15000). For slow jogging, check Button of speed 1/2/3 values.

troubleshooting.cause: Electromagnet presser foot dormancy time (Delay Setting) set to 0 — electromagnet stays active constantly
troubleshooting.solution: Set 'Electromagnet presser foot dormancy time' to a positive value (e.g., 30s) so the solenoid enters low-power dormant state when idle.

troubleshooting.issue: Parameter file cannot be loaded from USB
troubleshooting.cause: Wrong .xhp file for this machine model, or USB not detected
troubleshooting.solution: Verify parameter file extension is .xhp. Note: parameter files vary by equipment model — mixing is prohibited. Use only the backup file saved from this specific machine.

troubleshooting.issue: Turning point stitches are too small or too large
troubleshooting.cause: Turning Point Speed settings — 1st through 10th speed after turning point control post-corner acceleration
troubleshooting.solution: Reduce 1st speed after turning point (default 1200 rpm) if stitches are too small at corners. Enable 'Inflection slow speed' for additional slow-down at corners.
